subject: Air freight quote request to EZE
body:
Dear Air Freight Team,

Could you please quote an all-in price in EUR for the fastest air freight option to EZE (Buenos Aires, AR)? Please include truck pickup from our site in Stuttgart, Germany (postcode 70498), and transport to the departure airport.

The shipment consists of 11 pieces of furniture samples, with a gross weight of 544 kg and a total volume of 1.86 cbm. It will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-28.

Please let me know the earliest pickup and arrival you can offer. Thank you for your assistance.

Mit freundlichen Gruessen / Kind regards
Jonas Kessler
Logistics Coordinator
Kessler Feinmechanik GmbH, Ulm
